note: Canonical palette reconciled across the wordmark, monogram, and YouTube banner by pixel sampling. Supersedes the per-asset sampled values previously listed in Brandkit/CLAUDE.md.

cream.source: wordmark, 22.0% of all pixels, the single most common color in the artwork

teal.source: banner flat fill, 26.9% of its teal cluster; monogram reads #104A56

gold.source: banner flat fill, 91.9% of its gold cluster; monogram reads #E8A232

gold-ink.role: gold when it must be readable text on cream
gold-ink.source: derived, same hue and saturation as gold, lightness dropped to pass AA

type.note: Set by Ryan 2026-08-18. Does NOT apply to the YouTube thumbnail template, which is locked to its own stack.

logo.clearSpace: 8% of the placed logo height, all four sides
